incidents.name: BUNN reflection deliver drain
incidents.notes: BUNN's reflective deliver() lowers the reflected supply so the liquidity pair's BUNN balance falls without a sync(), letting the attacker swap a small holding for the pair's WBNB at the stale rate.

sources.ref: onchain review: BUNN 0xc54AAecF5fA1b6c007d019a9d14dFb4a77CC3039 created 2021-04-20T23:10:44Z by 0x3e46da8914103c8e682bf96615d65fd43c509f58, unrelated to attack sender 0xe2512f5a3714f473ab2bc3d95e3459fde7cc4b28; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 52 WBNB left the BUNN/WBNB pair; 52 WBNB x $249.36 at incidentTimestamp 1687379215 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $12,967.
